name: deaneries
title: Deanery Directory: Diocese of Brooklyn (page modified 2026-06-06, read 2026-11-05)
command: pnpm diocese roster import brooklyn deaneries scratch/brooklyn-map-1/001-survey/deaneries.json
notes: Scraped by scratch/brooklyn-map-1/tools/deaneries.py. group is the deanery (B1-B11, Q1-Q11) and its region (Brooklyn West/East, Queens West/East), created by Bishop Brennan in 2023. One entry per parish (175, three more than the parish directory). A deanery is a consultation group, not a pastorate or a bulletin.
